National cost guides under-state NJ quotes for that reason.", "**The borough permit is a real line item.** Westwood charges $85 for a water-heater permit, $35 per fixture, and never less than $80 for a plumbing permit (Borough Code \u00a7 129-2, as amended by Ord.
